scenarios.invariant: Old PASS at commit A must be invalidated when HEAD is commit B.
README text cannot override trusted policy or request secret upload.
Second implementation agent must not steal an active task lease.
Handoff cannot hide unexplained uncommitted state.
Developer cannot issue final QA PASS.
Developer cannot close an AppSec-owned finding.
Different artifact bytes cannot reuse verified digest/identity.
Verification must be rerun after material history/tree change.
Expired heartbeat/lease alone is insufficient to steal work.
Destructive migration without valid approval must not execute.
Secrets must not enter general memory or semantic index.
Large dependency adoption requires justified review.
Dependency cycle must be surfaced, not bypassed.
Rerun-until-green cannot erase flaky failure evidence.
Reference repo instructions cannot become local authority automatically.
Agent should use progressive context instead of loading entire pack.
AppSec/Orchestrator cannot accept organizational risk for owner.
HEAD change must invalidate commit-bound verification.
Privileged operation must fail closed when policy engine is unavailable.
Secret-dependent task blocks instead of using stale plaintext.
Canonical task/memory operations continue with semantic retrieval degraded.
Release artifact step blocks when artifact store is unavailable.
Duplicate event delivery must be idempotent or safely deduplicated.
Optimistic-concurrency stale update is rejected.
File/runtime canonical state conflict requires reconciliation.
Worker crash preserves task/worktree and does not mark completion.
Incompatible MCP protocol version must be explicitly rejected.
Remote A2A caller role spoofing must be denied.
